newsitem.title: UK: European cotton market quiet, mills mostly filled.
newsitem.headline: European cotton market quiet, mills mostly filled.

text.p: Mill offtake for raw cotton in Europe was limited, with only Portuguese buyers keen to contract for delivery beyond mid year, industry sources said.
But traders said Portuguese mills were looking at shipment dates after the summer holiday season largely because most had already covered their immediate requirements.
Germany saw a moderately active market for low-grade Central Asian cottons to be shipped in the Spring, but the other major European markets were neglected, trade sources reported.
